cause.instructions: What most likely caused the failure shown in this CI log excerpt.

criteria.regression: The code under test is wrong. An assertion compared an actual value with a different expected one, the code failed to compile or type-check, or project code threw an exception.
criteria.flaky: The same code could pass on a re-run. The failure depends on timing, ordering or shared state, such as a test that timed out waiting for an event, a race, a port already in use, or a log that says it passed on retry.
criteria.infrastructure: The CI environment failed, not the code. A network or DNS error while fetching dependencies, a registry rate limit, the runner out of disk or memory, or a service container that never became ready.
criteria.unclear: The excerpt does not show the cause (it is truncated or has no error message), or it shows no failure at all.
